# Jubilees Chapter 44 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Jacob blesses Joseph's sons; the twelve tribes; Jacob's testament

---

**44:1** And in the first year of the fifth week of the forty-fifth jubilee, Joseph brought his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim to Jacob his father.

**44:2** And Jacob saw the sons of Joseph and said: "Who are these?" And Joseph said: "They are my sons whom God gave to me here in Egypt." And Jacob said: "Bring them to me that I may bless them."

**44:3** And Jacob blessed them, and he set Ephraim before Manasseh and blessed Ephraim before Manasseh.

**44:4** And when Joseph saw this, he was displeased and said: "Not so, my father, for Manasseh is the firstborn. Put thy right hand upon his head." And his father refused and said: "I know it, my son; I know it. He also shall become great. But his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations."

**44:5** And Jacob blessed them on that day: "In you shall Israel bless, saying: 'God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh.'" And he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

**44:6** And Jacob called all his sons and said to them: "Gather yourselves together that I may tell you what shall befall you in the last days."

**44:7** And Jacob blessed his sons one by one according to their place in the order of the tribes.

**44:8** And he said to Reuben: "Thou art my firstborn, my might and the beginning of my strength, pre-eminent in dignity and pre-eminent in power. Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou didst go up to thy father's bed; then thou defiledst it — he went up to my couch."

**44:9** And of Simeon and Levi he said: "Simeon and Levi are brothers; instruments of cruelty are their swords. My soul has not come into their counsel; my honor has not been joined to their assembly. For in their anger they slew men, and in their wantonness they lame oxen. Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel."

**44:10** And of Judah he said: "Judah, thy brothers shall praise thee; thy hand shall be on the neck of thine enemies; thy father's sons shall bow down before thee. Judah is a lion's whelp. The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs."

**44:11** And Jacob blessed all his sons and each one he blessed in turn according to his blessings. And he commanded them and said: "Bury me in the cave of Machpelah in the field of Ephron the Hittite."

---

*EMET notes: Jacob's blessing of Ephraim and Manasseh (vv.1-5) parallels Genesis 48. The crossed-hands blessing, favoring Ephraim over Manasseh, is preserved. Jacob's deathbed blessings of the twelve sons (vv.6-11) compress Genesis 49 significantly; only the blessings of Reuben, Simeon/Levi, and Judah are quoted here.*
